query: SELECT plaintiff_current_status, verdict, legal_fees FROM Legal_Case WHERE plaintiff_current_status != 'An Active Member Of The Bharatiya Janta Party In Kerala State' OR defendant_current_status != 'The trustee of Mr Boensch__ bankrupt estate';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: plaintiff_current_status <> 'An Active Member Of The Bharatiya Janta Party In Kerala State' OR defendant_current_status <> 'The trustee of Mr Boensch__ bankrupt estate'
